common_actions.label: Hustle
common_actions.text: Move up to your Speed.

common_actions.label: Charge
common_actions.text: Move up to your Speed in a straight line toward a target outside your Engagement Range, then make one melee attack.

common_actions.label: Dodge
common_actions.text: Until the start of your next turn, Attack Rolls against you have Disadvantage. This benefit ends immediately if you take damage.

common_actions.label: Defensive Stance
common_actions.text: Until the start of your next turn, melee Attack Rolls against you have Disadvantage. You may also Riposte if your parrying weapon allows it.

common_actions.label: Shield Wall
common_actions.text: Raise your shield. Until the start of your next turn, damage from attacks that hit you is dealt to your shield instead.

common_actions.label: Help
common_actions.text: Grant Advantage to another character's Skill Check or Attack Roll.

common_actions.label: Activate
common_actions.text: Use a psychic ability, item, or special feature.

common_actions.label: Ready
common_actions.text: Prepare an Action triggered by a specific event. When you perform it, your Initiative changes to that point in the turn order.

common_actions.label: Interact
common_actions.text: Manipulate an object or terrain feature within Engagement Range.

common_actions.label: Shove
common_actions.text: Attempt to push a creature within Engagement Range.

common_actions.label: Take Cover
common_actions.text: Move into cover provided by terrain within 1 space.

common_actions.label: Tactical Shift
common_actions.text: Move 1 space in any direction. Cannot move you into or out of Engagement Range with a hostile creature.

common_actions.label: Stand Up
common_actions.text: Remove the Prone condition from yourself.

common_actions.label: Opportunity Attack
common_actions.text: When a character you can see enters or leaves your Engagement Range: make one melee attack against them. Not provoked by Tactical Shift or forced movement.

common_actions.label: Initiate Grapple
common_actions.text: 1 Action; requires a free hand; target within Engagement Range. Both participants make a Grapple Test (2d10 + STR or AGI) — the winner controls the grapple. The roll becomes the DV the target must equal or beat; the target may choose to fail. If the target wins without a free hand, the grapple ends instead. Grappled: Speed 0; attackers have Advantage against grappled characters.

common_actions.label: Contest Control
common_actions.text: 1 Action. Make a Grapple Test against the other participant; the winner becomes the controller.

common_actions.label: Choke
common_actions.text: 1 Action, Range 1. Win a Grapple Test: 2d6 damage directly to the target's Hit Points; the target then makes a Fortitude Save (DV 13) or gains the Silenced condition.

common_actions.label: Drag
common_actions.text: 1 Action, Range 1. Win a Grapple Test: move up to 4 spaces, dragging the target with you. Ignores the Grappled Speed reduction.

common_actions.label: Human Shield
common_actions.text: 1 Action, Range 1. Win a Grapple Test: use the target as a shield against incoming damage until the start of your next turn or until you lose control. The target takes damage as a shield used by the controller. A dead target is considered an object.

common_actions.label: Pin
common_actions.text: 1 Action, Range 1. Win a Grapple Test: inflict the Restrained condition on the target. You may also choose to knock the target Prone.

common_actions.label: Toss
common_actions.text: 1 Action, Range 1. Win a Grapple Test: throw a target your size or smaller up to your Strength score in spaces. If thrown into a similar-or-smaller creature, make a STR Attack Roll opposed by that creature's Defense Roll — on a hit both take 2d6 damage. The thrown target lands Prone. Ends the grapple.
